title: ElderlyLN - AI-Powered Caregiver Management & Matching System
summary: An AI-driven caregiver management and matching platform for elderly care services in Sri Lanka, combining a mobile/web app with a Python ML matching model. Notebooks in the ML module use SDV's TVAESynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic training data for boosting the caregiver-matching classifier.
